title: Moment Domain v1
description: Unified Moment domain model shared across Server, Web, and Glasses.

id.description: Globally unique identifier. Client-generated for offline-first sync.

userId.description: Server-side internal user ID. Local MVP uses 'local-user'.

title.description: Short title, typically AI-generated or derived from voice input.

voiceInput.description: Original voice transcription that triggered the record.

type.description: Structured record type (ADR-0017). Registry-driven: general (free-form fallback) / bookkeeping / habit. Orthogonal to category; validated against the type payload schema in contracts/types/.

payload.description: Typed extension fields validated against the type schema (contracts/types/*.schema.json). Always {} for type=general. Payload validity is enforced by the type schema, not expanded here.

tags.description: User or AI assigned tags, deduplicated, max 5.

persons.description: People involved in the moment (ADR-0019). Optional, e.g. ['妈妈', '小王'].

event.description: Event/activity name this moment belongs to (ADR-0019). Optional, e.g. '家庭聚餐'.

source.description: user = confirmed by user, inferred = AI-generated.

valence.description: Positive/negative dimension. 0 = neutral, 1 = very positive. Optional, for future expansion. Note: v1 uses 0-1 (not traditional -1..+1) for simpler client implementation; negative valence is not represented in v1.

arousal.description: Calm/excited dimension. 0 = calm, 1 = very excited. Optional, for future expansion.

provenance.description: Moment origin info. Immutable after creation. Used for audit and data lineage.

deviceId.description: Device ID for device-originated Moments (e.g. Rokid glasses). Links to device_bindings table.

media.description: Read-only media snapshot populated by server on read. Empty on write (use assetIds).

thumbnailUrl.description: Short-lived signed URL for thumbnail. Null for media types without thumbnails (e.g. audio).

downloadUrl.description: Short-lived signed URL for original. Only in detail responses.

revision.description: Optimistic lock revision. 0 for pending local, incremented on each server update.

syncState.description: CLIENT-ONLY field for offline sync. Never persisted on server, never returned in server API responses. Glasses/local clients use this to track sync state. Excluded from server responses per ADR-0002.

deletedAt.description: Tombstone timestamp. null for active moments.

$comment: v1 fields are frozen. syncState is client-only and excluded from server responses. New fields require an ADR and schema version bump. type/payload were added as optional fields via ADR-0017 (record types MVP); persons/event added as optional description dimensions via ADR-0019; no v2 bump since all are additive and optional.
